_about: One source for the homepage 'Mapped so far' strip, /roster and scripts/atlas_stats.py. Mapped games come from Supabase atlas_catalog (status=ready) plus 'bundled' (maps that ship with the app). 'popularity' ranks titles for the footer only (biggest, most recognizable first; publisher-reported lifetime sales/players). Games not listed still count and still show on /roster; they just never make the footer.
